dialects.brokenBadge.description: A warning badge on a dialect file in the Dialects view: it isn't JSON or a dialect file's shape, so it adds nothing. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.cancel.description: The New Model File, Duplicate and Set Model dialogs' button: closes the dialog, changing nothing.

dialects.changedOutside.defaultMessage: This file changed outside Combwork while you were editing it.
dialects.changedOutside.description: A banner in the Dialects view: the dialect file changed on disk (an editor, git, another window) while it has unsaved changes here.

dialects.claimMoved.defaultMessage: {name} has model {model} now: {from} became a test copy.
dialects.claimMoved.description: A notice after a dialect file took a model another file had (HI-2523). {name} is the file, {model} the model ID, {from} the file that had it. Glossary: test copy.

dialects.claimTaken.defaultMessage: Another file of this folder, {by}, claims model {model} first: Auto never picks this one.
dialects.claimTaken.description: A warning on a dialect file whose model another file of the same CLI folder claims too (made outside Hive): {by} is that file, {model} the model ID. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.claimedBy.defaultMessage: {name} already has this model: it becomes a test copy.
dialects.claimedBy.description: Under the Model ID field of a dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): another file of the folder ({name}) claims the model; saving moves the claim, and that file keeps its texts as a test copy. Glossary: test copy.

dialects.copyLabel.description: A copy's suggested name in the Duplicate dialog. {name} is the file copied.

dialects.counts.defaultMessage: {overrides, plural, one {# text changed here} other {# texts changed here}} of {total, number}
dialects.counts.description: The Dialects view's count over a file's texts: how many it overrides, of every agent text.

dialects.create.description: The New Model File, Duplicate and Import dialogs' button.

dialects.defaultNow.description: In the Dialects view, beside an outdated override: Hive's current wording of the text. Glossary: Default (dialects), outdated.

dialects.delete.description: A button of a dialect file the user made: moves it to the Recycle Bin.

dialects.deleteMessage.defaultMessage: It goes to the Recycle Bin. Agents whose Dialect setting names it use Auto from their next launch.
dialects.deleteMessage.description: The confirmation before deleting a dialect file. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.deleteTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before deleting a dialect file. {name} is the file.

dialects.discard.description: The Dialects view's button: drops the file's unsaved changes.

dialects.duplicate.description: A button of a dialect file in the Dialects view: makes a test copy of it beside it (no model), to try on one agent. Glossary: test copy.

dialects.duplicateMessage.defaultMessage: The copy has the same texts. With a model, agents on Auto running it get the copy from their next launch. Without one it's a test copy, which an agent uses only when its Dialect setting picks it (Agent Settings).
dialects.duplicateMessage.description: The Duplicate dialog of a dialect file (HI-2523): what the copy is, with a model ID typed or without. Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.duplicateTitle.description: Title of the dialog naming a copy of a dialect file. {name} is the file. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.export.description: A button of a dialect file in the Dialects view: writes it as it is to a file you choose.

dialects.exported.description: A notice after exporting a dialect file. {path} is where it was written.

dialects.failed.description: A notice: an action on a dialect file failed. {name} is the file.

dialects.fileProblem.json.description: Why a text isn't a dialect file (Dialects view). Lower case: it follows a colon.

dialects.fileProblem.shape.defaultMessage: "{field}" is missing or of the wrong kind
dialects.fileProblem.shape.description: Why a text isn't a dialect file (Dialects view): one of its fields ({field}: name, model, texts) is wrong. Lower case: it follows a colon.

dialects.fileTarget.description: What failed to load, in "Couldn't load …": the dialect file shown. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.filter.description: The Dialects view's search box placeholder: filters the list of dialect files by name or model.

dialects.from.api.description: Where an inherited text in the Dialects view comes from: the API dialect file (callers with no session).

dialects.from.cli.description: Where an inherited text in the Dialects view comes from: the CLI's dialect file ({cli}: "Codex").

dialects.from.default.description: Where an inherited text in the Dialects view comes from: Hive's own wording (the Default). Glossary: Default (dialects).

dialects.from.file.description: Where a text in the Dialects view comes from: the file shown overrides it. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.from.model.description: Where an inherited text in the Dialects view comes from: a model file or test copy, {name}.

dialects.from.workspace.description: Where an inherited text in the Dialects view comes from: the workspace's dialect file.

dialects.gone.defaultMessage: This dialect file is no longer there.
dialects.gone.description: The Dialects view: the file shown was deleted or renamed meanwhile. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.group.api.description: A group of the Dialects view's list: the dialect file for callers with no agent session (scripts, curl). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.group.workspace.description: A group of the Dialects view's list: the workspace's own dialect file, which every agent's chain has. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.import.description: A button in the Dialects view (HI-2444): adds a dialect file from a file. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.importFolder.description: The Import dialog's choice of folder: a CLI's, or the API's.

dialects.importMessage.defaultMessage: It is checked against this Combwork's texts. If its model is already claimed in the folder, it comes in as a test copy.
dialects.importMessage.description: The Import dialog of a dialect file. Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.importName.description: The Import and Duplicate dialogs' field: the file's name.

dialects.importTitle.description: Title of the Import dialog of a dialect file. {file} is the file chosen.

dialects.imported.description: A notice after importing a dialect file. {path} is where it went.

dialects.importedCopy.defaultMessage: {path} imported as a test copy: its model is already claimed in that folder.
dialects.importedCopy.description: A notice after importing a dialect file whose model another file of the folder claims: it came in without a model. Glossary: test copy.

dialects.jsonBad.description: Under the Dialects view's JSON tab: the text as typed can't be read as a dialect file; {why} says why. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.jsonLeave.description: The button that drops the JSON typed since it last read as a dialect file, and shows the Texts tab.

dialects.jsonLeaveMessage.defaultMessage: The Texts tab can only show the file as it last read: {why}. Drop what you typed since then?
dialects.jsonLeaveMessage.description: The question when leaving the Dialects view's JSON tab with text that isn't a dialect file; {why} says why.

dialects.jsonLeaveTitle.defaultMessage: The JSON isn't a dialect file
dialects.jsonLeaveTitle.description: Title of the question when leaving the JSON tab with text that can't be read as a dialect file.

dialects.keepMine.description: The Dialects view's button on a file changed outside Hive: keeps the unsaved changes; the next Save writes over the change made outside.

dialects.kind.api.description: What the API dialect file applies to (scripts, curl), under its name in the Dialects view's list. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.kind.cli.description: What a CLI's dialect file applies to, under its name in the Dialects view's list; {cli} is the CLI ("Codex"). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.kind.copy.defaultMessage: Test copy: agents that pick it
dialects.kind.copy.description: What a test copy (a dialect file with no model) applies to, under its name in the Dialects view's list: only agents whose Dialect setting names it. Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.kind.model.description: What a model file applies to, under its name in the Dialects view's list: agents running that model ID ({model}, as Hive matches it). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.kind.workspace.description: What the Workspace dialect file applies to, under its name in the Dialects view's list. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.layerOff.description: A layer in a text's expanded view in the Dialects view, switched off: its text doesn't apply. {layer} is its name ("from Workspace").

dialects.listTarget.description: What failed to load, in "Couldn't load …": the workspace's dialect files. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.loading.description: The Dialects view while it reads the dialect files.

dialects.modelControl.defaultMessage: A model ID has no control characters or line breaks.
dialects.modelControl.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): the Model ID typed has a control character or a line break.

dialects.modelEmpty.description: The Set Model dialog of a dialect file (HI-2523): the Model ID field is empty.

dialects.modelOptional.description: The placeholder of the New Model File and Duplicate dialogs' Model ID field (HI-2523): left empty, the file is a test copy. Glossary: test copy.

dialects.nameCli.defaultMessage: "cli" is the name of the CLI's own file: choose another.
dialects.nameCli.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): the name "cli" is taken by the CLI's own dialect file (cli.json). Keep "cli" as it is.

dialects.nameEmpty.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): the Name field is empty.

dialects.nameEnd.defaultMessage: A name can't end with a dot or a space.
dialects.nameEnd.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): Windows doesn't keep a trailing dot or space in a file name.

dialects.nameInFolder.defaultMessage: {name} is already in this folder: choose another name.
dialects.nameInFolder.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): a file of that name ({name}) is already in the CLI's folder (names are compared without case).

dialects.nameLong.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): the name is too long; {max} is the limit.

dialects.nameProblem.defaultMessage: A name with no / \ : * ? " < > |, not starting with a dot.
dialects.nameProblem.description: The Import, New Model File and Duplicate dialogs: the name has a character Windows refuses in a file name, or starts with a dot. Keep the characters.

dialects.nameReserved.defaultMessage: {name} is a name Windows keeps for itself, as it does CON, NUL and COM1.
dialects.nameReserved.description: A dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): the name ({name}) is a Windows device name, which can't be a file's. Keep CON, NUL and COM1 as they are.

dialects.newMessage.defaultMessage: An empty file: it inherits every text until you change one in it. With a model, agents on Auto running it get this file from their next launch. Without one it's a test copy, which an agent uses only when its Dialect setting picks it.
dialects.newMessage.description: The New Model File dialog (HI-2523): what the new file is, with a model ID typed or without. Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.newModel.description: A button on a CLI's group in the Dialects view (HI-2523): makes an empty dialect file for a model of that CLI. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.newTitle.description: Title of the New Model File dialog (HI-2523). {cli} is the CLI ("Codex"). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.noDefault.defaultMessage: No current Default: this text was removed or renamed in this Combwork.
dialects.noDefault.description: In the Dialects view, beside an outdated override whose id this Hive no longer has. Glossary: Default (dialects), outdated.

dialects.noMatch.description: The Dialects view's texts with a search or filter that matches none.

dialects.noPlaceholders.description: In a text's expanded view (Dialects view): its text has no placeholders.

dialects.noWorkspace.defaultMessage: Open a workspace to see its dialects.
dialects.noWorkspace.description: The Dialects view with no workspace open. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.none.description: A layer with no text of its own in a text's expanded view (Dialects view). A dash: keep it short.

dialects.notSeen.defaultMessage: No agent has run this model yet.
dialects.notSeen.description: Under the Model ID field of a dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): no agent of the workspace has run that model ID. Information only: the file can be made for it anyway.

dialects.note.description: In a text's expanded view (Dialects view): the note beside the text in Hive's code, saying where it is used.

dialects.onFailed.description: A notice: switching a dialect file on or off failed. {name} is the file. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.onSwitch.description: A dialect file's on/off switch in the Dialects view, for screen readers. {name} is the file's name. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.onTip.defaultMessage: On: its texts apply. Off: {to, select, cli {it falls back to the {name} file} workspace {it falls back to the Workspace file} other {it falls back to Combwork's Default}}. Changes apply at each agent's next launch.
dialects.onTip.description: Tooltip on a dialect file's on/off switch in the Dialects view: what its texts fall back to when it is off. Select keys (keep them): cli, a model file or test copy, which falls back to its CLI's file ({name}: "Claude Code", "Codex"); workspace, a CLI's or the API's file, which falls back to the Workspace file; other, the Workspace file, which falls back to Combwork's own wording. Glossary: dialect, Default (dialects).

dialects.outdatedBadge.description: A warning badge on a dialect file in the Dialects view: how many of its texts no longer match this Hive's (they fall through to the layer below). Glossary: outdated.

dialects.outdatedGroup.description: The Dialects view's group of a file's overrides that no longer match this Hive's texts: they fall through to the layer below until edited or removed. Glossary: outdated.

dialects.override.description: A button on an inherited text in the Dialects view: starts this file's own override of it, from the text it inherits.

dialects.placeholders.description: In a text's expanded view (Dialects view): the placeholders its text must have, exactly ({names}: "{project}, {count}").

dialects.problem.changed.description: Why a dialect override is outdated or refused: placeholders of its text ({id}) are used as another kind (a number as a plain value, say) ({names}).

dialects.problem.extra.description: Why a dialect override is outdated or refused: its text ({id}) has placeholders its id doesn't take ({names}).

dialects.problem.missing.description: Why a dialect override is outdated or refused: its text ({id}) lacks placeholders it needs ({names}: "{project}, {count}").

dialects.problem.shape.description: Why a dialect override is outdated or refused: its entry ({id}) isn't an object with a text and an optional reason. "text" and "why" are the file's field names: keep them.

dialects.problem.unknown.defaultMessage: {id}: no such text in this Combwork (removed or renamed).
dialects.problem.unknown.description: Why a dialect override is outdated or refused: its id ({id}) isn't one of this Hive's texts.

dialects.problem.unparsable.description: Why a dialect override is outdated or refused: its text ({id}) isn't valid message syntax; {detail} is the parser's English error.

dialects.promote.description: A button of the user's own dialect files (a test copy, a model file they made or imported) in the Dialects view (HI-2523): sets the model ID the file is for, which Auto picks it for (a file that had that model becomes a test copy). Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.promoteField.description: The Model ID field of the New Model File, Duplicate and Set Model dialogs (HI-2523): the model ID the file is for ("claude-opus-5-5", "qwen3:32b"), typed or picked from those agents have run.

dialects.promoteMessage.defaultMessage: Agents on Auto running this model ID get this file from their next launch. A file that had the model keeps its texts, as a test copy.
dialects.promoteMessage.description: The Set Model dialog of a dialect file (Dialects view). Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.promoteTitle.description: Title of the Set Model dialog of a dialect file (HI-2523). {name} is the file. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.refresh.description: A button in the Dialects view: reads the dialect files again.

dialects.refused.changedOnDisk.defaultMessage: The file changed outside Combwork since you started editing it: nothing was saved.
dialects.refused.changedOnDisk.description: A dialect file's save refused: it changed on disk meanwhile (an editor, git, another window). The view then offers Reload or Keep My Changes.

dialects.refused.file.description: A dialect file's save or import refused: the text isn't JSON or a dialect file's shape; {why} says what.

dialects.refused.missing.description: A change to a dialect file refused: the file ({path}) was deleted meanwhile.

dialects.refused.modelClaimed.defaultMessage: {by} already claims model {model}: a folder has one file per model.
dialects.refused.modelClaimed.description: A dialect file's save refused: another file of the folder ({by}) claims the same model ID ({model}). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.refused.modelHere.defaultMessage: Only a model file or test copy in a CLI folder can have a model: not the Workspace, CLI or API file.
dialects.refused.modelHere.description: A dialect file's save refused: it names a model, where none may be. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.refused.nameTaken.defaultMessage: {path} is already there: choose another name.
dialects.refused.nameTaken.description: A dialect file's import or copy refused: a file of that name ({path}) exists. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.refused.notYours.defaultMessage: Only your own model files and test copies take Set Model: not a shipped file, nor the CLI, API or Workspace files.
dialects.refused.notYours.description: A dialect file's Set Model refused (HI-2523): the file is one Combwork ships, or a CLI's, the API's or the Workspace file. Glossary: dialect, test copy.

dialects.refused.path.defaultMessage: That isn't a dialect file's place.
dialects.refused.path.description: A dialect file's save, import or copy refused: its path isn't one Hive accepts.

dialects.refused.protected.defaultMessage: The Workspace file, a CLI's file and a shipped file can't be deleted.
dialects.refused.protected.description: A dialect file's delete refused: it is part of the chain's baseline (a shipped one has Revert).

dialects.refused.title.description: Heading of the reasons a dialect file was refused (Dialects view): nothing was written.

dialects.reload.description: The Dialects view's button on a file changed outside Hive: reads it again, dropping the unsaved changes.

dialects.removeOverride.description: A button on a text this dialect file overrides: removes the override, so the text inherits again.

dialects.restart.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Restart to apply: {agents} runs on this file as it was.} other {Restart to apply: {agents} run on this file as it was.}}
dialects.restart.description: A banner on a dialect file in the Dialects view: running agents whose dialect chain this file changed since their launch; they get the change when they restart. {agents} is their names. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.revert.description: A button of an edited shipped dialect file: puts back the file as Hive ships it. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.revertMessage.defaultMessage: Your changes to it are lost, and it follows Combwork's updates again.
dialects.revertMessage.description: The confirmation before reverting a dialect file to the version Hive ships. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.revertTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before reverting a dialect file. {name} is the file.

dialects.save.description: The Dialects view's Save button: writes the file's changes, checked against this Hive's texts first.

dialects.saved.defaultMessage: {name} saved: it applies at each agent's next launch.
dialects.saved.description: A notice after saving a dialect file. {name} is the file. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.savedAs.defaultMessage: Saved as {model}, the ID agents run it as.
dialects.savedAs.description: Under the Model ID field of a dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): what was typed is an alias or a form of a model ID the CLI knows, saved as its real ID ({model}).

dialects.saving.description: The Dialects view's Save button while it saves.

dialects.search.description: The Dialects view's search box over a file's texts (by id or wording).

dialects.select.defaultMessage: Choose a dialect file to see every text it gives agents.
dialects.select.description: The Dialects view with no file chosen. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.show.description: The label of the Dialects view's filter of texts (All, Changed in this file, Changed anywhere).

dialects.show.all.description: The Dialects view's filter: every agent text.

dialects.show.anywhere.description: The Dialects view's filter: the texts this file or a layer beneath it overrides. Glossary: layer.

dialects.show.here.description: The Dialects view's filter: only the texts this file overrides.

dialects.showMore.description: A button under a long group of texts in the Dialects view: shows more of them.

dialects.state.edited.description: A badge on a dialect file in the Dialects view: shipped with Hive, and changed here (Revert puts it back). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.state.shipped.description: A badge on a dialect file in the Dialects view: as Hive ships it. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.state.yours.description: A badge on a dialect file in the Dialects view: one the user made (a copy, an import), not Hive's. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.tab.json.description: A tab of a dialect file in the Dialects view: the file's JSON text, to edit as text.

dialects.tab.texts.description: A tab of a dialect file in the Dialects view: every text, with the file's overrides.

dialects.tabs.description: The Dialects view's tabs (Texts, JSON), for screen readers. {name} is the file.

dialects.text.description: The field for an override's text in the Dialects view.

dialects.tip.defaultMessage: The wording Combwork gives agents: its guidance, its tools' descriptions and replies, its wakes. A dialect file changes some of it, for a model, a CLI or the whole workspace; everything else stays Combwork's own. A change applies at each agent's next launch.
dialects.tip.description: Tooltip on the Dialects view's title (HI-2444). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.title.description: Title of the Dialects view (HI-2444): the wording Hive gives agents, tuned per model and CLI. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.unresolvedAlias.defaultMessage: {model} is an alias Combwork can't resolve now: agents running it show as model unknown, so this file wouldn't match. Type the model's ID.
dialects.unresolvedAlias.description: Under the Model ID field of a dialect file's dialog (HI-2523): the text typed ({model}: "opus") is one of the CLI's aliases, and its catalogue doesn't say which model it stands for.

dialects.updateBadge.description: A badge on an edited shipped dialect file: this Hive ships a newer version (Revert brings it in). Glossary: dialect.

dialects.usedBy.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Used by # running agent: {agents}} other {Used by # running agents: {agents}}}
dialects.usedBy.description: Tooltip on the agents count of a dialect file in the Dialects view: the running agents whose dialect chain has it, by name. Glossary: dialect.

dialects.why.description: The field for an override's reason in the Dialects view: why it is worded so (shown to whoever reads the file).

dialects.whyPlaceholder.defaultMessage: What it fixes, and how it was measured
dialects.whyPlaceholder.description: The placeholder of an override's Why field in the Dialects view.
